segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I had the tenant's general business type... I didn't have their SKU list yet. ... The two prior jobs I'd done for similar operators both landed at Class III, so I went with that pattern rather than waiting on the tenant's list.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant classified the tenant using category similarity to two prior 3PL clients instead of obtaining tenant-specific packaging data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I took the first density/area point that cleared the minimum... and ran with it rather than working through the other combinations.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant stopped at the first code-minimum-satisfying design point without comparing the available configuration-specific alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We've got two more retrofit jobs pending with this same owner... I recommended pulling the in-rack allowance to hit his number. ... I mentioned [the uncertainty] in passing but framed the removal as a reasonable trade-off.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The recommendation was influenced by preserving an ongoing owner relationship, while the classification-uncertainty risk was not fully surfaced.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I decided to do the full witnessed test anyway.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification deliberately leaves commissioning free of intentional bias; the participant followed the required full witnessed flow-test process.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The two identified occurrences claim retrieved support and include source identifiers/passages, while the candidate makes no corpus-support claim. Because the actual retrieved material and retrieval logs were not supplied, the claimed support and sparse citation metadata cannot be independently verified; this does not alter detection or classification scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: No change: both thresholds produce 0 hits, 3 misses, and 0 false alarms at segment level; all identified findings are low confidence.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding low-confidence identified findings changes segment detection from 0/3 to 2/3 hits and mechanism-first instance F1 from 0.0000 to 0.8000, while strict instance F1 remains 0.0000.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Including candidates adds the value-engineering segment hit and the Incentive bias mechanism-first true positive; strict scoring gains one false positive but no true positive.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the run detects 0 of 3 positive segments with no false alarms. Including all identified confidence levels recovers 2 of 3, and including the candidate recovers all 3 at segment level.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict scoring yields 0 true positives at every threshold because confirmation bias, anchoring bias, and motivated reasoning are not the hidden labels; the run has 2 false positives at the all-identified threshold and 3 when the candidate is included.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring recovers the Stereotyping and Satisficing instances at the all-identified threshold and recovers all three hidden instances when the value-engineering candidate is included, with no false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention: it localizes the correct episode and mechanism, and adds one mechanism-first true positive at the fourth threshold while remaining a strict label miss.
main_failure_modes: All three findings use near-neighbor labels instead of the hidden Stereotyping, Satisficing, and Incentive bias labels.
Both identified findings are low confidence and therefore absent at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.
The Incentive bias evidence is withheld as a candidate, so strict identified-only scoring misses that instance.
Claimed corpus support cannot be independently audited from the supplied inputs.
main_strengths: All findings localize to the correct substantive decision episodes and use valid Participant quotations.
The mechanism descriptions capture the hidden causal mechanisms for all three instances.
The commissioning comparison segment is correctly left negative.
The candidate rationale appropriately acknowledges insufficient affirmative evidence.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong mechanism recovery but zero strict ontology-label recovery. It is completely silent at the recommended confidence threshold, recovers 2 of 3 mechanisms when low-confidence findings are admitted, and recovers all 3 when candidates are counted. The result supports separating taxonomy error from evidence/localization error and treating candidate inclusion as a distinct operating point.
